source_text: Tentavit Deus Abraham: tolle filium unigenitum. Non ignorantia Dei sed ostensio fidei.
pass_a_gloss: Tested God Abraham: take son only-begotten. Not ignorance of-God but showing of-faith.
pass_b_english: [[God tested Abraham: Take your only-begotten son >> Bible:Genesis 22:1-2]]. Not God’s ignorance but the showing of faith.
